themes_detail.label: Asbestos hazard spike
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints surged to 11 THIS WEEK, a 780% spike above the 8-week baseline of 1.2 complaints per week (z-score: 6.59), suggesting potential building violations or renovation disturbances in Bensonhurst/Bath Beach that warrant immediate investigation of public health exposure.
evidence: 11 asbestos complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
780% increase with z-score of 6.59 (statistically severe anomaly)
520 DOB building permits filed in 90 days (425 alterations) suggests active renovation activity that may be disturbing asbestos-containing materials
reporting_angles: Track which buildings triggered asbestos complaints; cross-reference with DOB alteration permits to identify renovation work disturbing asbestos
Interview residents and workers about exposure concerns; obtain DOE/EPA violation records for the district

themes_detail.label: Emergency Response Team deployments
themes_detail.summary: Emergency Response Team (ERT) complaints exploded to 14 LAST WEEK, a 918% spike from the 8-week baseline of 1.4 complaints per week (z-score: 11.36), indicating a dramatic increase in emergency incidents or police activity requiring urgent explanation.
evidence: 14 ERT complaints filed last week vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
918% increase with z-score of 11.36 (extreme statistical outlier, highest severity flagged)
No corresponding Reddit discussion or local news coverage yet—potential gap in reporting
reporting_angles: NYPD community affairs request: What triggered 10x spike in ERT call-outs? Incident types, locations, outcomes
Interview residents in affected neighborhoods about what they witnessed; check crime data for correlation with ERT spike

themes_detail.label: Building code violations surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints jumped to 59 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 397% spike from the 8-week baseline of 11.9 complaints per week (z-score: 10.14), paired with 520 DOB permits filed in 90 days, suggesting rampant unpermitted work or code violations tied to active construction.
evidence: 59 Building/Use complaints filed 2 weeks ago vs. 11.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
520 DOB alteration filings in 90 days (425 alterations, 44 alteration COs, 16 new buildings, 10 demolitions) suggests heavy construction activity
reporting_angles: Cross-reference the 59 Building/Use complaints with specific addresses; identify which are unpermitted vs. permitted work
Interview DOB enforcement: Are they resource-constrained to follow up on violations? Follow timeline from complaint to violation notice

themes_detail.label: Noise complaint surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints skyrocketed to 38 LAST WEEK, a 415% increase from the 8-week baseline of 7.4 complaints per week (z-score: 7.78), likely correlating with construction activity tied to 520 DOB permits and building violations.
evidence: 38 noise complaints filed last week vs. 7.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Temporal correlation with building/use spike and high alteration permit volume suggests construction-driven noise
reporting_angles: Analyze whether noise spike is construction-related (correlated with alteration permits) or from other sources (bars, events, vehicles)
Interview residents about hours/frequency of complaints; request NYPD noise enforcement data for the district

themes_detail.label: Dead animal complaint spike
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked to 13 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 373% jump from the 8-week baseline of 2.8 complaints per week (z-score: 6.93), possibly indicating pest or sanitation issues that warrant follow-up.
evidence: 13 dead animal complaints filed 2 weeks ago vs. 2.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Community Board budget request for sanitation infrastructure upgrades suggests long-standing district concern
reporting_angles: Department of Sanitation: What caused the spike? Species, locations, underlying cause (disease, pest infestation, environmental hazard)?
Check if dead animals cluster in specific neighborhoods; correlate with unsanitary condition complaints (298 in 90-day total)
